Status Update:
Postgresql DB provisioning can fail in some scenarios with the following generic error - _Failed to apply VM Best Practices_

In this scenario software profile was created from a VM where /var/lib/pgsql is on a separate disk from OS boot disk. 

When you check traces of errors - in operation id file(under logs/drivers/postgres_database/provision/<operation-id>.log) you can see similar errors:
./logs/logs/drivers/postgres_database/provision/98305372-0c19-47f9-832c-b0b23c99e2b7.log:    "touch: cannot touch '/var/lib/pgsql/.bash_profile': Permission denied",
./logs/logs/drivers/postgres_database/provision/98305372-0c19-47f9-832c-b0b23c99e2b7.log:    "sed: can't read /var/lib/pgsql/.bash_profile: No such file or directory",
...
./logs/logs/drivers/postgres_database/provision/98305372-0c19-47f9-832c-b0b23c99e2b7.log:    "bashconfig.sh: line 10: /var/lib/pgsql/.bash_profile: Permission denied",
 

 If you debug issue by disabling rollback and keep the failed provisioned VM up, you can observe that the permissions on the PostgreSQL home directory ({_}{{/var/lib/pgsql}}{_}) are incorrect compared to the golden image VM.

For example, the golden image VM displays the correct permissions for the _{{/var/lib/pgsql}}_ directory below:
 
{code:java}
[root@vwbrsbclvhpost1 var]# ls -ld /var/ /var/lib/ /var/lib/pgsql 
drwxr-xr-x. 21 root root 4096 May 5 20:45 /var/  
drwxr-xr-x. 37 root root 4096 May 7 16:52 /var/lib/  
drwx------ 3 postgres postgres 4096 May 21 14:12 /var/lib/pgsql{code}
{{}}
However, on the failed provisioning VM, the permissions for the directory appear with root ownership instead of postgres:


{code:java}
[postgres@Postgresql17-vm2 /]$ ls -ld /var/ /var/lib/ /var/lib/pgsql 
drwxr-xr-x. 21 root root 4096 May 21 15:52 /var/ 
drwxr-xr-x. 37 root root 4096 May 7 16:52 /var/lib/ 
drwxr-xr-x 2 root root 4096 May 7 16:44 /var/lib/pgsql{code}
